title: Quarterly Anchor Plan: Hosted Endpoints + Catalog Slices (Signal Windows & Tactical Rollouts)
creator: Maya Patel
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Q2 Runway
description: Define the quarterly anchor (primary commitments and buffer lanes) for Hosted API and the Model Catalog to align OKRs, guard capacity, and surface signal windows for canaries. This ticket synthesizes initiative slices (small, testable deliverables) that map to operational runways, canary schedules, and deprecation steps for underperforming models. Outcome: a prioritized set of slices that PM/ENG/DES agree can be executed in Q2 with explicit rollback/backstop policies.
acceptance_criteria: A prioritized list of 6-9 slices with owners and acceptance tests
Canary windows scheduled with rollback criteria documented
Capacity hedge plan that maps slices to Dedicated capacity thresholds
Design/PRD and runbook links provided for each slice
Stage gating defined (canary -> staged -> GA) and monitoring dashboards identified
risks: Model health regressions discovered late in canary requiring unexpected rollbacks
Capacity contention during seasonal traffic increases could force tranche delays
Cross-team dependencies (SRE infra changes, infra-privileged configs) may slip
Ambiguous ownership on slice-level metrics leading to slow sign-off
decisions: Adopt three-tier commit lanes: Anchor (commit), Buffer (hedge), Experiment (opt-in)
Prefer short, measurable slices (~2 week lead to canary) over large cross-functional bets this quarter
Use the staged fallback policy: model-variant -> lower-capacity region -> cached responses
Reserve a 10% Dedicated capacity buffer for high-traffic canaries during public launches

2026-03-08 - Sofia: We should fold KV-cache tuning into the first slice to reduce per-token cost before ramping canaries.

2026-03-12 - Lucas: Updated prioritized slices after stakeholder feedback; moved one experiment into the 'opt-in' bucket to preserve anchor lanes.
next_steps: Lock slice owners and acceptance tests by 2026-03-14
Schedule canary windows in deployment calendar and notify CS (by 2026-03-16)
Create PRDs for slice 1 (KV-cache tuning) and slice 2 (model variant fallback)
Eng to estimate infra work and flag any capacity cost delta
notes: This artifact intentionally limits scope to hosted endpoints and the public model lineup; Dedicated-only enterprise features will be tracked in a sibling PM ticket. We prioritize early measurable wins that reduce unit cost or materially improve latency while maintaining a safe rollback surface.
